title: Pre-push review becomes a fail-closed gate with a round budget
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is deleted, so `osf review run` now exits non-zero on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run. To keep a builder from looping forever, a new round budget in `review_run` counts failed rounds per worktree in the journal state directory and lets the push through once the limit is passed; a could-not-run streak instead ends blocked with a message. A credential preflight in `reviewers` decides a missing key or login before any reviewer process starts, and `secret_values` now also scrubs string leaves of agent login files. osf's own `.osf/` output is filtered out of the changed-file set so a review round cannot change which lenses the next round selects.

nodes.label: moon `review` task
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --if-enabled --work-item …
nodes.summary: The pre-push task. It loses `--warn-only` and gains `--work-item .osf/out/work-item.txt`, so the review reads the spec the develop skill wrote. Its exit code now gates the push.

nodes.label: .osf/out/work-item.txt
nodes.subtitle: written by the develop skill
nodes.summary: The work item body the review reads. It lives under `.osf/out`, which is exactly the kind of osf output the changed-file filter now ignores.

nodes.label: review run / reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code, review_reduce_exit_code
nodes.summary: The command entry points. `--warn-only` is gone from both argument structs, and the exit code is now the plain result of `finish_review`.

nodes.label: finish_review
nodes.subtitle: verdict + blocking findings → exit code
nodes.summary: Prints the outcome, writes SARIF, posts when asked, then decides the code. A kept must-fix or should-fix finding forces 1 regardless of verdict. When `count_rounds` is set (run, not reduce) it consults the round budget before returning.

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundCounts, RoundKind
nodes.summary: The new pre-push budget. A pass clears the counts; a findings round increments and allows the push once past the limit; a could-not-run round increments and returns an error past its own limit, so a missing credential never becomes a silent pass.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new fields with defaults of 3, rejected when zero. The default whole-run timeout drops from 2700s to 1800s.

nodes.label: setup / changed files
nodes.subtitle: lens selection input
nodes.summary: `setup` now drops every path starting with `.osf` from the changed set before lens selection, so a review round's own counter or SARIF write cannot change which lenses the next round picks.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: untracked filter
nodes.summary: Untracked files under `.osf/` are filtered out of the risk assessment's changed set, for the same reason: osf's own output is not part of the change a person made.

nodes.label: preflight_and_not_run
nodes.subtitle: credential check before any worker
nodes.summary: Decides, before a worker starts, whether a reviewer has no way to sign in. A reviewer already skipped for a more specific reason, or with no read-only mode, is not judged again.

nodes.label: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: credential_env / login_paths
nodes.summary: Returns a reason when every credential variable is empty and every login path is absent under the real home. Templated reviewers and the test escape hatch are exempt.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: login_values, json_leaves
nodes.summary: Scrubbing now also collects every string leaf of the agents' JSON login files, so a provider key kept in opencode's auth file is removed from output like an environment secret.

nodes.label: review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.subtitle: journal state dir
nodes.summary: One counter file per canonicalised worktree path, keyed by a hash, holding the findings and could-not-run counts. It lives in the journal state directory, outside the worktree the builder can edit.

nodes.label: journal::state_dir
nodes.subtitle: run journal
nodes.summary: The existing state directory that already holds the run journal; the round counter is a new subdirectory of it.

nodes.label: Reviewer agent
nodes.subtitle: claude / opencode / codex
nodes.summary: A model agent answering one lens. It now carries a `templated` flag, and its login file's string leaves are treated as secrets.

nodes.label: agent login file
nodes.subtitle: .local/share/opencode/auth.json, .codex/auth.json
nodes.summary: Where an agent keeps its provider key. The preflight checks it exists; the scrubber reads its leaves.

edges.label: --work-item, no --warn-only
edges.summary: The task now passes the work item and no longer asks for a warning-only exit; the command's code is the push's code.
Both run and reduce route through `finish_review`; only run passes `count_rounds = true`.
The exit code is no longer the verdict alone: the budget decides whether a failing round may still stop the push.

edges.label: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
edges.summary: The limits come from `[review]` in the trusted config root.

edges.label: load / save / clear
edges.summary: Each round reads the counter, increments its own field and writes it back; a pass removes the file.
The counter sits under `review-rounds/` inside the journal state directory, so the builder's worktree cannot reset it.

edges.label: .osf/ filtered
edges.summary: Both the lens-selection input and the risk assessment now drop osf's own output paths.
Each reviewer run asks the preflight before starting a worker.
The preflight delegates the credential judgement to the reviewer.

edges.label: exists?
edges.summary: A login path counts only when the file exists under the real home.

edges.label: no worker starts
edges.summary: When the preflight finds no credential, every lens is recorded could-not-run and no agent process is spawned.

edges.label: string leaves
edges.summary: The scrubber reads the login files and treats their string leaves as secrets to remove.
The unchanged path: a reviewer with a credential runs its lenses.

flows.title: One pre-push review round
flows.summary: What happens between the builder's `git push` and the exit code that decides whether the push proceeds.

messages.label: does this reviewer have a credential?
lenses answered
messages.note: Skipped entirely when the preflight finds no credential: every lens is recorded could-not-run instead.

messages.label: allowed?
messages.note: A pass clears the file and returns 0. A findings round returns 1 until the count passes the limit, then 0. A could-not-run round returns 2, and past its limit an error naming the block.

messages.label: exit 0 / 1 / 2
messages.note: The push proceeds only on 0; the builder fixes findings and pushes again.
